messages.subject: Quartz - diligence report and negotiation plan
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Good work on the IP DD report. Two things to carry into the licence: (1) the Meridian research licence on QX-2 must be a Permitted Encumbrance and reflected in the warranties; (2) flag the QX-4 Japan office action (due 28 Feb) as a specific disclosure. On the negotiation, hold firm on the 125% cap and the 750k minimum royalty - those are our red lines for Gregory. Expect Birchall Stone to come in low on both.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
